subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw support MiniMax Token Plan image generation through api.minimax.chat and add a scoped subagent skill/bootstrap contract for that workflow, or keep the current dedicated image endpoint plus AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only subagent boundary?
rationale: Current source shows both disputed behaviors are intentional on main, and changing either one affects provider routing and subagent context boundaries rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Verify and add a narrow Token Plan path
options.body: Use live MiniMax Token Plan evidence to add the smallest provider/media-routing change while preserving the existing subagent bootstrap boundary unless a specific skill contract is approved.

options.title: Create a scoped subagent skill contract
options.body: Define and document which skill bundles can be made available to subagents without restoring broad parent-session file inheritance.

options.title: Keep current core behavior
options.body: Close the core request after documenting the dedicated endpoint behavior and directing Token Plan workflows to an external tool, plugin, or ClawHub path.

recommendation.title: Verify and add a narrow Token Plan path
recommendation.body: Use live MiniMax Token Plan evidence to add the smallest provider/media-routing change while preserving the existing subagent bootstrap boundary unless a specific skill contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses provider routing, subagent bootstrap policy, and current-main maintainer direction, and steipete is the most plausible recent area router among the identified history.
